title: Love Makes the Difference
coreMove: Felt love builds a security climate where spouses can face work stress, self-worth fears, and practical conflicts without turning each hard talk into combat at home.

exampleSpecs.stakes: Keep outside pressure from making the marriage another enemy line.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a loved spouse carrying vocation uncertainty and outside enemies into a secure home.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses mistaking polite words for understanding
exampleSpecs.stakes: A calm exchange can still hide defensive listening.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Expose false communication through preferred meanings and defensive listening.

exampleSpecs.audience: couples whose practical conflict turns personal
exampleSpecs.stakes: A repair estimate can become a fight for self-worth.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Contrast a battlefield response with a haven response.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses who read delay as devaluation
exampleSpecs.stakes: A small delay can trigger fear that one person does not matter.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show that being loved contributes to a sense of significance.

exampleSpecs.stakes: A full tank can make a difference discussable after avoidance.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Show a full tank lowering fear of condemnation.

exampleSpecs.audience: spouses who leave arguments feeling endangered
exampleSpecs.stakes: The next sentence can turn the room toward threat or haven.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Repair a battlefield moment by removing the threat to self-worth.
